pl-l4d25c4-d1e115.summary: Rejects the objection of those who say they buy not consecrations but the goods that come from consecration: whoever sells one of two things, without which the other is not had, leaves neither unsold.
claims: Selling what is inseparable from the spiritual is simony.

pl-l4d25c4.summary: Rejects the excuse that one buys not the consecration but the goods that come from it: whoever sells one of two things without which the other is not had sells both.
claims: Buying the revenues of a consecration is buying the consecration.
